title: An ending leaves living fruits of hope

captions.physics: Ending an earlier form of participation

meaning: Shared closure of an earlier form through hope for possibility is emotionally accompanied by warmth from particular fruits of shared care.
text: An ending can leave a creative aftertaste. Death in the physical position of this Energy Field appears through shared actions that end an earlier form or phase. The Star in energy motivates openness to possibility, shared attention and the sustaining of hope. The Empress in emotions adds warmth from care and tangible growth. You may already be closing particular participation while keeping a prospect open, and emotionally enjoy something living or comfortable that your shared attention produced and that does not disappear with the earlier form.

For example, you complete a season of open sessions about planting a courtyard. You hand over remaining materials and close the timetable, hoping that interest in the plants may continue differently. On an ordinary walk, you notice flowering boxes you made together. **This form has ended, while the fruits of our attention continue to please us.** Warmth concerns a particular result of care; it does not promise that another season will happen or look the same.

A difficulty arises if visible growth becomes proof that continuation is compulsory. One person is satisfied with closure, while the other already takes another shared burden for granted. Hope loses openness and becomes a demand. The Empress in emotions requires no endless increase in results, and the Star guarantees no future form. Death concerns an actual phase ending, which does not need to be cancelled in order to recognise what it produced. Its value can remain after participation finishes.
